name: @workspace/tools-shared
description: Pure code shared by the tools and their hosts (D14): randomness (random), bytes as hex (hex), Base64 (base64), instants for people (time), the exact JSON scanner (json-scan), a strict DER reader (der), how deep markup nests before the HTML parser sees it (html-depth), a test of an algorithm's growth (growth) — the modules the tool specifications name — and the tool history (D17): the record envelope, the filter model, the HistoryStore seam with its in-memory default and shared contract suite, the archive format, the cipher seam (WebCrypto) and the history factory every tool records through.
